description: Dismissible inline banner shown above the action stack when an auth attempt fails (network/OAuth/5xx). Never blanks the screen; brand + CTAs stay intact. Renders null when there is no error.

message.default: Check your connection and try again.
message.description: Supporting body; swap to offline copy when detectable

onRetry.description: Optional; re-invokes the failed auth method

accessibility.colorIndependent: icon (warning) + word ('Couldn't sign in') carry meaning, not color alone
